capital_enablers.label: Capital Enablers (AI capex / HALO)
capital_enablers.rationale: Semiconductors, data-center power/cooling, grid buildout and industrial automation: heavy-asset, low-obsolescence beneficiaries of the capex boom.

labor_heavy.label: Labor-Heavy (staffing / office / per-seat SaaS)
labor_heavy.rationale: Staffing agencies, IT outsourcers, commercial office REITs and per-seat software: revenue scales with headcount and is exposed to AI substitution.
